summary: CPW river ranger Jeff Hammond rescued a mother and daughter whose cataraft was trapped in a recirculating hole in the Class IV-V Three Rocks Rapid area near Pinnacle Rock on the Arkansas River; the mother was bucked out of the craft and swept downstream, leaving the daughter stranded aboard; Hammond kayaked to the cataraft, climbed aboard, replaced a broken oar, and guided the craft downstream to where commercial raft guides had gathered the mother; both uninjured and continued downriver.
location: Three Rocks Rapid, Arkansas River (Browns Canyon area, near Pinnacle Rock)
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife (Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area) river ranger Jeff Hammond
